question: Owner 2026-11-03 '我们的那几个live策略，测试一下，使用ema cloud这个指标 默认参数 20 50 50 … 基于12h级别，只做一边，比如红色云带只做空，绿色云只做多，12h。4h。1h的都试试，live原有的所有规则都不变'
single_variable: Admission only: a candidate is taken when its side matches the EMA cloud colour of the last bar closed at the decision (green EMA20 > EMA50 long only, red short only); fills, stops, targets, sizing, seeds and costs of each live- account unchanged

indicator.name: EMA Trend (owner Pine v4) with fast 20, medium 50, slow 50
indicator.colour: green when EMA(fast) > EMA(slow), red when EMA(fast) < EMA(slow); medium does not set the colour
indicator.ema: alpha 2/(n+1), seeded with the SMA of the first n closes (Pine ema); undefined before n bars
indicator.bars: Resampled from the 5m (1m for crypto_1m jobs) execution series, UTC epoch alignment (12h bars open 00:00 / 12:00 UTC)

causality: Cloud of the last bar whose close is at or before the decision time: live-wick* = the touch 5m close (market entry, entry_t); live-allin3 = the open of the 5m fill bar (the limit rests before the touch; entry_t is that bar's close)
no_colour: Candidates whose EMA50 is still undefined (too few bars since listing) or equal are not taken under the filter (no colour = neither side); counted separately

arms.base: no filter (must reproduce the saved account exactly)

control.rule: Random subsets of the account's own candidates (same start) with the with-cloud arm's size, replayed with the account's allocator and seed; share of draws below the filtered account. Metric: final multiple (live-wick*), trading P&L after refills = end - 1000 - cash added (live-allin3)

fees: Unchanged from the saved fills: market entry taker 0.05 percent + 10bp, target maker 0.02 percent, other exits taker + 10bp (live-wick); maker limit entry 2bp and 10bp non-target slippage (live-allin3); worse intrabar path; funding not modelled
limits: Binance bars, not the OKX paper feed; live-wick touches 2026-10-28..31 not covered (no Binance 2026-10-28 archive); live-allin3 ends 2026-09-23. Timeframes and the 20/50 lengths are owner-given, not selected here.
